sloka: रोषात् प्रस्फुरमाण ओष्ठः सुग्रीवम् प्रति लक्ष्मणः ।ददर्श वानरान् भीमान् किष्किंधाया बहिः चरान् ॥४-३१-१७॥
transliteration: roṣāt prasphuramāṇa oṣṭhaḥ sugrīvam prati lakṣmaṇaḥ ।dadarśa vānarān bhīmān kiṣkiṁdhāyā bahiḥ carān ॥4-31-17॥

translations.english: His lips trembling in anger, Lakshmana saw fierceful monkey guards of Sugriva at the entrance of Kishkinda city.
